services.name: Horse Leader
services.desc: Ridgebury Farm’s Wellness Horsemanship is a premier riding program offering high-quality instruction for riders of all abilities. Our experienced instructors provide a strong foundation in riding skills, grounded in classical dressage, while also offering an adaptive program for riders who need additional support. All lessons include ground work and mounted work, helping riders develop horsemanship, balance, coordination, and confidence. Typical riders build technical skills and equestrian knowledge, while those in the adaptive program receive tailored guidance to succeed safely and comfortably. blurb: Ridgebury Farm provides evidence-informed, animal-assisted and nature-based therapies led by licensed clinicians, including occupational, physical, speech, and psychotherapy. Their Wellness Horsemanship program blends traditional horsemanship with emotional awareness and leadership, offering both traditional and adaptive lessons. Early Childhood programs include Nature-Based Learning for ages 2–4 and Mommy + Me classes for ages 0–3 and their caregivers.
